why: What a plugin may use, each with a version raised only when it changes in a way that breaks its users. A plugin.json lists what it uses in "uses": {"<name>": <version>}; one this engine does not offer at that version is not turned on (blocked). "also": older versions still offered. "transitional": still works, but release.py check-plugin reminds that it goes away (the words say what replaces it). "paths" and "modules": the files under the engine a plugin may run, read or import for it; "functions": the public ones of a module, "others": what check-plugin says about the rest; "commands": when several interfaces share a path, the words (subcommands) that tell which one a file uses.

dc.post.what: altention dc post (--file, --wait, --board, --activity, --create; @audit, @notify), and with --file x.png the file x.png.source.json beside it, what the picture was drawn from (altention/sources.py: kind, lang, tool, source). A change to that file's format raises this version.

tmux.what: altention tmux list [machine] --json, read <id> [lines], send <id> text [--enter] [--reason] | --keys K… (written to #audit first; exit 4 refused, 5 #audit did not take it): tmux:// identifiers of panes (altention tmux -h); exit 0, 2 a wrong id, 3 no such pane or another one there now, 255 the machine not reached

dcremote.tmux.what: dcbot/tools/dcremote tmux-list MACHINE and tmux-read ID [LINES], run on the machine whose panes they are (over ssh from another): JSON of tmux:// identifiers as altention tmux gives them; each pane says "claude" by the command lines under it; read's text masked there; exit 2 a wrong id, 3 no such pane or another one there now; a dcremote older than 0.6.0 exits 1

dcremote.files.what: dcbot/tools/dcremote files (JSON in and out; every result has "v" since 0.6.0, and raw reads a part with offset, length and same)

activity.pages.what: plugin.json "activity": {"pages"} and what the bot writes for a page opened; 2: a page's "opens_files" and "file_button", the buttons on files posted with altention dc post --file (args {"machine", "path"}); a plugin that says 1 gets no such buttons

plugin.format.what: plugin.json as the engine reads it; 2 (v0.6.0): a uses entry may be {"v": N, "optional": true}, and altention plugins uses <plugin> [--json] says at run time which of its uses can be used; 3 (C-163): a step's "on" may say "standby", every machine of the list with the role dcbot-standby (an engine before it takes the word for a machine name and reports it); 4: "standby": true on a "machines": "one" plugin runs it on those machines too, unless the instance's "on" says where (an engine before it ignores the key: the bot's machine alone)

tokens.what: {engine} {plugin} {python} {claude} {instance} {data} {root} {setting:...} in plugin.json, and DCBOT_CHANNEL; 2: needs[].install is filled in too (an older engine shows it as written)

py.config.what: altention.config: root, instance_dir, settings, setting, machines, this_machine, engine_on, ssh_aliases
py.config.others: altention.config 的其他函式不公開，之後可能改名或拿掉
